description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Permishield XV 70 is an Australian-made, fibre-free, closed-cell thermo-reflective insulation and sarking engineered specifically for framed and reverse brick veneer walls behind lightweight claddings[][][]. It combines thermal insulation, a thermal break, and a vapour-permeable sarking pierced with evenly spaced breather holes into a single 3-in-1 product[][]. It protects the wall structure from external water penetration while allowing internal moisture vapour to escape, significantly reducing interstitial condensation risk[][].

rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Permishield XV 70 is an Australian-made 7.2mm thick, 3-in-1 thermo-reflective insulation, thermal break, and Class 3 vapour-permeable sarking. Manufactured with a closed-cell polyolefin core sandwiched between reflective foil facings and pierced with micro-breather holes, it provides an in-situ material R-value of R0.20 to satisfy NCC thermal break provisions on steel-framed walls. It allows internal moisture vapour to breathe outward while blocking external liquid water, making it the premier choice behind lightweight claddings and reverse brick veneer wall assemblies.

rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Permiwall is a discontinued 5.5mm thermo-reflective insulation and vapour-permeable membrane engineered specifically for internal concrete and masonry block walls. Comprising a micro-perforated closed-cell foam core between reflective foil facings, it allowed moisture vapour to permeate rather than condense against cold masonry, while reflecting radiant heat into the living space. Installed over furring channels or clips beneath plasterboard, it provided an ultra-slim thermal solution that helped achieve 6-star residential energy ratings without sacrificing floor area.

description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Retroshield is a fibre-free, high-performance thermo-reflective insulation and vapour barrier comprising an encapsulated 7mm air cell core faced on both sides with reflective aluminium foil[][][]. Engineered to combat heat gain and loss via radiation, convection, and conduction, it features an anti-tear surface that provides superior strength during retrofit and new build applications[][]. It is non-allergenic, non-irritant, and CodeMark certified for NCC compliance across residential and commercial buildings[][][].

rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Retroshield is a 7mm thick, fibre-free thermo-reflective insulation blanket comprising an encapsulated air cell core sandwiched between two highly reflective aluminium foil facings. Designed for roofs, ceilings, walls, and sheds in both new build and retrofit scenarios, it delivers an R0.14 material R-value, an Extra Heavy Duty rating, and a Flammability Index of 3 to AS 1530.2. By blocking radiant heat, convective currents, and air leakage, it dramatically moderates internal temperatures and controls roof condensation in metal-clad and industrial buildings.

Designed for small residential projects such as garden sheds, workshops, garage doors, and camper conversions, it provides the same 7mm encapsulated air cell structure and dual aluminium foil facings as commercial rolls. It effectively blocks radiant heat transfer and stops condensation without the material surplus of standard 30m² rolls.

rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Retroshield XL was an upgraded commercial variant featuring a cross-linked closed-cell foam core sandwiched between plain reflective aluminium foil facings on both sides. Formulated to offer higher thermal buffering and enhanced structural durability compared to standard bubble core insulation, it served large-span commercial roofs, warehouses, and industrial wall envelopes. Formerly CodeMark certified under certificate CM20001, it has since been superseded in Kingspan's contemporary product portfolio.

rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Spacer Biscuits are 60 x 60 x 20 mm expanded black polyethylene spacers designed to create and preserve a nominal 20mm reflective airspace between Kingspan AIR-CELL reflective insulation and adjacent wall substrates. Slit for rapid placement over standard wire wall ties and featuring an adhesive backing for repositionable installation against foil facings, they guarantee the reflective air cavity necessary to achieve rated system R-values. They are fibre-free, inert, and non-deteriorating, making them essential for cavity brick, brick veneer, and framed wall installations.

rag_summary: Ametalin Accessories encompass the specialised range of tapes, fasteners, and thermal isolation components developed by Ametalin to ensure compliant installation of building membranes. Including double-sided fixing tapes, reinforced foil duct tapes, plastic cap nails, and thermal break strips, these products eliminate thermal bridging, wind displacement, and moisture leakage across steel and timber frames. They ensure residential and commercial wall wraps, roof sarkings, and underfloor foils achieve their designed airtightness, condensation control, and energy ratings.

description: Ametalin Cavity Drainage Battens are an innovative triple-layer, high-density polypropylene, self-adhesive passive open air-flow strip specifically designed to isolate and create ventilation, cavity drainage, and thermal separation behind roof and wall cladding[][]. Installed between pliable building membranes and exterior cladding or roofing sheets, they provide a firm base to install to while creating a natural drainage plane for moisture to escape[][]. In metal roof assemblies, they help locate and maintain the dew point at the underside of the roof cladding to prevent condensation from forming on the pliable membrane[].

rag_summary: Ametalin Cavity Drainage Battens (CDB-451200) are 45 mm x 1200 mm x 10 mm self-adhesive, open-air-flow strips manufactured from a high-density triple-layer polypropylene core. Engineered for application over pliable membranes on steel and timber wall framing and metal roofs, they establish a durable ventilation and drainage plane (RT 0.15 in-situ) that directs trapped moisture away from building fabrics. Highly compression-resistant and stackable to 20mm to meet NCC 2022 condensation management and energy efficiency provisions, they prevent interstitial moisture damage, mould growth, and roof condensation.

Release liner-free and hand-tearable, it features the thickest premium-grade adhesive in the Ametalin range to provide instant high tack and airtight integrity[][][].

features.rag_summary: Ametalin QuickTape (QuickTape Blue) is a high-performance woven polymer fabric tape coated with an aggressive cold-weather acrylic adhesive, designed specifically for joining and sealing pliable building membranes. Featuring a release-liner-free design and hand-tearable construction, it accelerates installation while eliminating jobsite rubbish. Operating reliably from -30°C to over 80°C, it provides airtight and vapour-tight seams across Ametalin VapourTech wall wraps, roof sarkings, and duct penetrations to ensure high-performance envelope integrity and Passive House compliance.

features.description: Autex Accent Ceiling Tiles are a simple, modest, high-performance acoustic tile designed to fit within standard suspended grid systems and comply with typical loading standards[][][]. Made from non-woven, needle-punched 100% polyester fibre containing a minimum of 60% post-consumer recycled content, the tiles are lightweight yet sturdy, ensuring they will not chip, crack, or break during or after installation[][][]. Developed with two functional sides for creative flexibility, they feature one smooth classic white face and one vibrant coloured face to deliver an NRC rating of 0.85 (Class A sound absorption)[][][].

features.rag_summary: Autex Accent Ceiling Tiles are lightweight, high-performance acoustic tiles measuring 595 x 1195 x 12 mm, engineered to drop directly into standard 600 x 1200 mm suspended ceiling grids. Manufactured in New Zealand and Australia from 100% polyester fibre with a minimum of 60% recycled PET, they feature a reversible dual-sided design (smooth classic white on one side and a choice of over 20 vibrant colours on the other). With an outstanding NRC of 0.85 (Class A sound absorption), Group 1 fire classification, and certified carbon-neutral credentials, they solve commercial noise reverberation without chipping, cracking, or releasing airborne fibres.
